accounts.title.note: Accounts page heading and document title.

accounts.balance.none.note: Account row balance when no points balance has been read. This is unknown, not zero, and is not a sign-in failure.

accounts.default_label.note: Fallback account label. number is its one-based position, not an identifier.

accounts.empty.title.note: Empty Accounts state, if displayed before the shell returns to setup.

accounts.empty.body.text: Sign in, then pick when the app checks for points

accounts.empty.action.note: Empty-state action navigates to setup, not an undocumented add-account API.

accounts.action.signin.note: Starts add_account only while there is no configured account.

accounts.action.add_another.note: Disabled button above a configured account list. The adjacent explanation states the current second-account limit, not an available action.

accounts.action.signin_again.note: Calls sign_in_again for an existing account, also for updated Microsoft terms.

accounts.action.rename.note: Opens the inline account label editor.

accounts.action.more.note: Closed per-account disclosure replacing always-visible Rename, Pause or Resume, and Remove buttons. Sign in remains outside; no action or confirmation is removed.

accounts.action.pause.note: Excludes the selected account from scheduled runs, subject to last-active validation.

accounts.action.resume.note: Returns a paused account to active runs.

accounts.rename.label.note: Label of the shared textField in the inline rename editor, maximum forty characters.

accounts.rename.description.text: This changes the name in the app, not your Microsoft account
accounts.rename.description.note: Explains that renaming writes only the local label.

accounts.root_pause.text: This older account cannot be paused. Use a Manual schedule to stop scheduled runs.
accounts.root_pause.note: Visible reason for no Pause action on the root profile, per section 8.4.

accounts.remove.title.note: Destructive confirmation title. account is a user-supplied label, isolated by i18n.

accounts.remove.body.text: Remove it from the app. You can keep its browser data, or send it to the Recycle Bin. This does not delete your Microsoft account.
accounts.remove.body.note: Removal dialog for a named profile, explains both delete_data choices.

accounts.remove.root_body.text: This older account can only be removed with its browser data. The data goes to the Recycle Bin. This does not delete your Microsoft account.
accounts.remove.root_body.note: Root-profile confirmation, delete_data must be true. Use Windows' official localized Recycle Bin name.

accounts.remove.keep.note: Destructive action calls remove_account with delete_data false for a named profile.

accounts.remove.delete.text: Remove and move data to the Recycle Bin
accounts.remove.delete.note: Destructive action calls remove_account with delete_data true. Use the official localized Windows Recycle Bin name.

accounts.remove.success.note: Shown only after remove_account succeeds, never for root_recycle_failed.

accounts.signin.title.note: Heading above the active or terminal sign-in status.

accounts.signin.starting.note: SigninStatus starting, the app has requested a sign-in process.

accounts.signin.waiting.text: Finish signing in using the Edge window. If Windows is already signed in with a Microsoft account, the app may connect that account for you.
accounts.signin.waiting.note: SigninStatus waiting. Do not suggest choosing a second Microsoft account. The connection happens only when Windows itself is signed in with a Microsoft account.

accounts.signin.verifying.text: Checking that your sign-in was saved
accounts.signin.verifying.note: SigninStatus verifying after the visible window closes or the first balance check misses it.

accounts.signin.signed_in.note: SigninStatus signed_in; a terms_of_use warning can still follow.

accounts.signin.failed.text: Sign-in could not finish. Try again.
accounts.signin.failed.note: SigninStatus failed fallback when no specific error message_key was supplied.

accounts.signin.timed_out.text: Sign-in took too long. Try again when you are ready.
accounts.signin.timed_out.note: SigninStatus timed_out, fifteen-minute limit, do not claim the account was deleted.

accounts.signin.cancelled.note: SigninStatus cancelled, shown only after cancellation is confirmed by status.

accounts.signin.busy.text: A run is using Edge. Wait for it to finish, then try signing in again.
accounts.signin.busy.note: SigninStatus busy, distinct from a bridge response error.

accounts.signin.cancelling.note: After cancel_signin accepts the request, before the cancelled terminal push.

accounts.signin.terms.text: Accept Microsoft's terms in the sign-in window before continuing
accounts.signin.terms.note: Instruction when signed_in carries error_code terms_of_use.

accounts.signin.retry.note: Retry label for a terminal failed, timed_out, cancelled or busy state.

accounts.migration.title.note: Synthetic compatibility confirmation for accounts.migration_needed. F24 currently refuses a second add first.

accounts.migration.confirm.note: Retries add_account with confirm_migration true after explicit confirmation.

accounts.load.title.note: Bridge fetch failure heading, followed by the localized error and retry action.
